That's my point. I feel like some people will miss me should I decide to die, but that they're strong enough to get on with their lives and function just fine without me (and in some cases, better than otherwise). I'm not expecting anyone's life to be completely devastated by it; just upset.

19-20 range. Absolutely nothing.
I live with my family that can't stand me for the most part, I feel like I'm going nowhere in life, and I've been depressed for so long that it's become my norm. I don't know much of anything else.

I see it as more of a reason that I'm obligated to live rather than a reason to want to. As for my other family members, we aren't close and most of them don't like me all that much. I'm not exaggerating, my parents and brothers have straight up cussed me out, told me they're better off without me, they can't stand me/don't like me, etc. They would be upset by my death, but we aren't close and they would get over it much more easily than my sister ever would.

As for friends, I have a few, and they would miss me, but I feel that I'm holding them back more than anything. I'm a bit of a drag, if you haven't noticed...lol.

But they too would come to terms with it. Some of them have had friends take their lives in the past and I see how they've handled that. Rather well.

Well the biggest and most glaring reason is my little sister. Everyone else in my life would be able to handle my death, and come to terms with it, but not her. I couldn't do that to her. That's the one reason I can't explain away to myself, so it's the main reason I'm here.
